page.notes: Long s is rendered as plain s throughout, so "fuæ ipfius" reads "suæ ipsius" and "eft" reads "est". Printed "Act." uses a ligature for "ct" which I have expanded to "Act.". The word "è" is printed with a grave accent and is kept as such. The page ends mid-word at "vi-" and continues on the next page; no catchword is printed. The page contains no visible paragraph indents, so the text is treated as one paragraph.
